title: Towards Measuring Supply Chain Attacks on Package Managers for Interpreted Languages
sections_checked: §§III–IV pipeline, manual verification and malicious-package findings
§V-B measurement limitations and threats to validity
evidence_note: MALOSS reported 339 new suspicious/malicious packages and maintainers confirmed/removed 278, but this is not an unbiased estimate of ecosystem prevalence; static analysis accuracy and dynamic coverage are limited, platform and file-type scope is narrow, and pipeline is evadable.

title: Simulation-based Testing for Early Safety-Validation of Robot Systems
sections_checked: §§III–IV MCTS procedure, human model and proof-of-concept setup
evidence_note: Across three intentionally seeded robot-cell hazard scenarios, MCTS found hazards in 8–10/10 seeds vs random 3–8/10 within 200 episodes; simple 30-action human model, static reachability octree, three scenarios, and falsification-only semantics mean this is not a safety guarantee.

title: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming
sections_checked: §6 continual learning and streaming setup/results, Tables 1–4
Appendix D memory-size and proxy studies
Appendix E hyperparameter selection and compute details
evidence_note: Coreset improves some task-based and imbalanced streams but authors report no gain over reservoir on balanced CIFAR-10 streaming. β is selected by best test-set performance, creating possible optimistic selection bias. Proxy, memory regime and runtime also constrain transfer.
